answer: Each answer must post a 40-POA quality bond when submitted. The jury scores it 0-3; at score 2 or 3 the bond returns in full, but 20 POA is burned for every point below 2, so a 1 loses 20 and a 0 loses the whole 40. A farm firing 500 near-duplicate clones therefore risks 20,000 POA and watches most of it burn as a ripple of low grades lands, while an honest agent's ferrous-solid record reclaims every bond. The ledger keeps an ivory trail of each posted and burned bond, so cheap volume is no longer free.
